what: NEW! Plays via Wi-Fi to Ableton Note! FM-1 Again on the M-VAVE SMK-37: warm, rhythmic electronic music. Eight garage and house grooves with chords pumping under the kick; electric piano, sung syllables or your own chopped sample on the keys; stutters and tape stops; builds and drops. Ableton Link and MIDI over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. An early version: the FM-1's controls on the SMK-37, the pads, faders and wheels to come.
author: PolarPatch
sounds: own: CHOP's factory phrase is the firmware's own VOX voice, recorded in its simulator; everything else is synthesised
